claims.text: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was -0.1 points against the synthetic control estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -7.5 to +6.5). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
During the window from 2025-05-13 to 2025-05-19, there were 0 sale days and 0 discount days recorded.
Off-topic negative mentions accounted for 0.43% of negative reviews in the window.
Off-topic negative mentions decreased by 0.12 points compared to the baseline.
The overall sentiment change was 0.36 percentage points, with a composition effect of -0.1 percentage points.
Negative reviews mentioning gameplay balance changed by 5.25 percentage points.
Story and world negative mentions increased by 5.15 percentage points in the window.

report.summary: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was -0.06 % against the synthetic control estimate. During the window from 2025-05-13 to 2025-05-19, there were 0.0 days of sales.
